select sc.category_id, sc.name, sc.slug, sc.description, (select count(*) from sys_article sa where sa.category_id = sc.category_id) as article_count, sc.create_time, sc.update_time from sys_category sc
and sc.name like concat('%', #{sysCategory.name}, '%')
order by sc.create_time desc

SELECT t.category_id, t.name, t.article_id, t.title, t.slug, t.cover_image, t.view_count, t.like_count, t.comment_count, t.published_time, ( select group_concat(tg.name order by tg.tag_id separator ',') from sys_article_tag at join sys_tag tg on tg.tag_id = at.tag_id where at.article_id = t.article_id ) as tag_names FROM ( SELECT sc.category_id, sc.name, sa.article_id, sa.title, sa.slug, sa.status, sa.cover_image, sa.view_count, sa.like_count, sa.comment_count, sa.published_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sc.category_id ORDER BY sa.published_time DESC ) AS rn FROM sys_category sc LEFT JOIN sys_article sa ON sc.category_id = sa.category_id where sa.status = 1 ) t WHERE t.rn <= 6 OR t.rn IS NULL ORDER BY t.category_id, t.published_time DESC;
